frontmatter.description: Ask a local Grok Build CLI for a bounded second opinion when the user explicitly requests Grok, then critically reconcile its structured review. Use for Polish or English requests to ask, send, pass, or delegate a brief or implementation plan to Grok. Automatic review is implemented but disabled until a dedicated authenticated profile passes real acceptance.
